GENERATE BURST KL-9-S — Run C-9 P4, M3 helm VISOR consistency (Matt: "Nope, the first 3 are still different.."), direction S. task_id "KL-9-S".

Use image_gen in EDIT mode on IMAGE 1 (the knight, painted in the hand of a c. 1530 Flemish manuscript, background flat green). Replace ONLY his HELM so that it is the same helm as in the other directions: he is facing the viewer straight on: the helm is the one in IMAGES 2 and 3 seen from the FRONT, halfway between them — the same rounded skull, and the same ROUNDED, close-fitting visor now seen face-on as a smooth curved plate with a single row of small holes along its edge. NOT a pointed or beak-shaped visor, no grille.
Paint it in EXACTLY the same hand as the rest of IMAGE 1 (same red-brown pen hatching on pale steel). Keep EVERYTHING ELSE exactly as it is: body, direction, pose, gorget, tabard and heraldry, the pollaxe in his right hand, framing, flat pure #00ff00 background. For this step the REGISTER CARD above is satisfied BY THE IMAGES: do not re-render or restyle.

One image_gen EDIT call. ONE retry only if the visor is still pointed/beak-shaped or otherwise unlike the reference helm, anything else changed, or the background is not flat green — name the reason. Copy the output to out/KL-9-S.png with sha256. No code. No other files. No web.
RETURN: receipt task_id "KL-9-S"; images = the file with prompt, references (role + path) and elapsed_s; calls_used = the TRUE number of image_gen calls; status; concerns. Never PASS/FAIL.

references.role: IMAGE 1 — THE IMAGE TO EDIT (replace only the helm; direction S)
IMAGE 2 — HELM REFERENCE: the knight's helm from the lower-right diagonal (copy only the helm design)
IMAGE 3 — HELM REFERENCE: the knight's helm from the lower-left diagonal (copy only the helm design)
